pages.flat_page_sub.other: {count} pages with the “{template}” template. These are ordinary pages: they open in the same editor.

pages.chip_hint_missing: {version}: there is no version yet, so this page is not on the site in this language. Click to create it.
pages.chip_hint_draft: {version}: draft, not on the site yet. Click to open it in the editor.
pages.chip_hint_changed: {version}: has unpublished edits ({changes}). Click to open it in the editor.
pages.chip_hint_published: {version}: published. Click to open it in the editor.
pages.url_slash: The address must start with a slash, for example /about-us
pages.url_spaces: The address must not contain spaces: use a hyphen
pages.url_double_slash: Two slashes in a row are not allowed in the address
pages.url_chars: The address may contain Latin letters, digits and hyphens. Replace other letters with Latin ones
pages.url_reserved: Addresses that start with /{code} belong to the {version} of the site. Choose a different address
pages.url_taken: This address is already taken by the page “{title}”
pages.url_help_prefix: The address of the {version} always starts with {prefix}. Then a slash and the name in Latin letters, for example /about-us.
pages.url_help_prefix_redirect: The address of the {version} always starts with {prefix}. After publishing, visitors are redirected from the old address to the new one automatically.
pages.url_help_plain: Starts with a slash, for example /about-us.
pages.copy_source_required: Choose the page to copy the sections from
pages.url_auto_note: The address is made from the title.
pages.start_empty_about: One first screen with the page title. You will add the other sections in the editor.
pages.start_copy_about: All sections with their texts and photos are copied. You can change them later.
pages.copy_source_label: Page to copy the sections from
pages.new_draft_note: A new page is saved as a draft: it will not be on the site until you click “Publish”.
pages.new_main_note: The page is created {language}: this is the main language of the site. You will add versions in other languages in the editor, and each will have its own texts and address.
pages.settings_note: You are setting up the {version} of this page. The title, address and search description are separate for each version; the place in the structure is the same for all languages.
pages.settings_note_home: You are setting up the {version} of this page. The title, address and search description are separate for each version.
pages.template_change_message: The new template has no fields {fields}: their content will be removed from the page in all languages. It cannot be restored.
pages.seo_heading: How the page looks in search
pages.seo_desc_empty: No description: the search engine will take a piece of text from the page.
pages.seo_title_help: If left empty, the search engine will show the page title.
pages.seo_desc_help: One or two sentences about what a person will find on the page.
pages.saved_note_multi: Edits will be saved in the draft of the {version} and will reach the site when it is published.
pages.saved_note: Edits will be saved in the page draft and will reach the site after publishing.
pages.sub_names_fallback: Titles and addresses are {language}; pages without a translation show the {name}.
pages.sub_switch_hint: The language is switched in the menu on the left; the language label in a row opens that version of the page.
pages.sub_open_hint: Open a page to edit its sections.
pages.home_locked_note: The home page cannot be unpublished or deleted.

pages.version_missing_note: This page has no {version} yet: create it to edit the texts and address.
pages.version_missing_title: No {version}: the title from the main language is shown
pages.settings_no_version: This page has no {version} yet: create it first
pages.created_toast: Draft “{title}” created. It will not be on the site until you publish it
pages.settings_saved_published: Settings saved. They will reach the site after publishing

pages.delete_live_one: The page will disappear from the site, and the address {url} will stop opening. It can be restored from the trash.
pages.delete_draft: This is a draft and it is not on the site. The page can be restored from the trash.
pages.delete_with_versions: All its versions will be deleted with it: {names}.
pages.delete_hint_one_version: To remove only one version, choose “{action}”.

pages.delete_version_draft: This is a draft and it is not on the site.
pages.delete_version_tail: Versions in other languages will stay as they are. A deleted version cannot be restored.
pages.tree_home_locked: The home page is always first, its place does not change

pages.subtitle_default: All pages of the site and their place in the structure.
pages.arrange_note: Drag a page by the handle on the left to put it in another place or inside another page. The keyboard works too: Alt and the arrow keys. Each move is saved at once.
pages.missing_title: This page is not on the site in the chosen language
pages.flat_empty_text: Add the first one: the page will get the “{template}” template at once.
pages.nothing_found_text: Try changing the search or show pages of any template and status.
pages.empty_text_can: Create the first page of the site.
pages.empty_text_cant: There are no pages for your role yet.
